FX-THRESHRGB-001.says: As added: every threshold 128, no Invert, Blend 0: each channel on its own, red stays pure red, green pure green, both skins white, grey 127 black; the same as Channel Threshold's RGB at 128 (FX-CHTHRESH-004).

FX-THRESHRGB-002.says: Red 230, green 128, blue 50: the lit skin (246, 214, 190) stays white, the shadow skin (220, 160, 140) loses its red and turns cyan, the light grey (192) loses its red too.

FX-THRESHRGB-003.says: Invert Green only: green turned over in every pixel, so pure green turns black, pure red yellow and both skins magenta.

FX-THRESHRGB-004.says: All three inverted: FX-THRESHRGB-001 turned over, white black and pure red cyan.

FX-THRESHRGB-005.says: Blend With Original 50: every pixel halfway, in linear light, between the drawing and FX-THRESHRGB-001.

FX-THRESHRGB-006.says: Red 0, green 255, blue 128: red full in every shown pixel, green only where it is full (green and white), blue as at 128.

FX-THRESHRGB-007.says: Red keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 255 at frame 4, linear: frame 2 is red 127.5.

FX-THRESHRGB-008.says: Blend eased from 50 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it is held at 100, the drawing.

FX-THRESHRGB-009.says: FX-THRESHRGB-002 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-THRESHRGB-010.says: Red Threshold 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESHRGB-011.says: Green Threshold -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESHRGB-012.says: Blue Threshold keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESHRGB-013.says: Invert Red written "true", not "on" or "off". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESHRGB-014.says: Blend With Original -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
